races.name: Sandygate Inn, Kingsteignton 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Our Guide
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up horse with excellent recent form including a win, but 21 days off and needs to overcome October Hill's weight advantage.

runners_data.name: Granpa Ger
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with strong course record but 144 days absence is a significant concern despite solid historical form.

runners_data.name: October Hill
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with crucial 7lb weight pull but poor recent win record raises questions about finishing power under pressure.

runners_data.name: Oscar Jack
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced unknown quantity with concerning fade tendency but potential for improvement on second hurdles start.

runners_data.name: Getone
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up horse dropping in grade but recent poor form and lowest rating make victory unlikely despite 10-day freshness.

races.paceDynamic: October Hill will be the sole pace-setter from the start, with his prominent style making him the natural leader in this small field. Behind him, Our Guide, Granpa Ger and Getone will all be held up tracking the leader, creating a tactical waiting game where the front-runner could steal a march if given an easy lead. With three hold-up horses relying on October Hill to provide the gallop, this race sets up perfectly for a horse that can travel strongly and sustain a challenge from off the pace. This race shape clearly favours horses with proven finishing kick who can time their run from behind the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If October Hill gets soft fractions and builds an unassailable advantage turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader's 7lb weight advantage becomes crucial as he kicks clear before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. Our Guide and Granpa Ger find themselves with too much to do despite their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If Our Guide or Granpa Ger time their run perfectly and catch October Hill in the final 100 yards
scenarios.body: The superior class of the hold-up horses tells as October Hill's lack of recent wins becomes exposed under pressure. Fresh legs and higher ratings prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Getone finds significant improvement dropping in grade and catches the field napping
scenarios.body: The lightly-weighted hold-up horse benefits from being underestimated while the favourites mark each other. Recent run at this track gives tactical advantage in timing the challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Upset Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Oscar Jack shows dramatic improvement on second hurdles start and handles the pace better
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runner finds natural progression stepping up in trip with the fading tendency less exposed over this distance. Jimmy Frost gets the tactics spot-on from an unheralded position.

watchPoints.text: October Hill could steal this if allowed to dictate completely uncontested fractions from the front
Granpa Ger's 144-day layoff may blunt natural finishing speed despite strong historical form figures
Our Guide's ability to close the 7lb weight gap on October Hill will determine the finish
Oscar Jack's previous fading tendency could resurface if pace becomes truly testing
Getone needs significant form reversal but trainer Hitchins has 1 winner from 9 recent runners

races.name: New Inn, Alphington, Exeter Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Green Sky

runners_data.name: Rangatira Jack

runners_data.name: Mr Jukebox
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose style requires strong pace to be effective, but Warren Greatrex's poor recent form is concerning.

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent winning form who could benefit if the pace becomes overly strong, but needs the race to unfold perfectly.

runners_data.name: This Sway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent victory who should get ideal position tracking the leaders without overexerting early.

runners_data.name: Imperial Jade
runners_data.note: Class front-runner returning from 124-day break whose tactical speed could dictate terms if fitness holds up.

runners_data.name: Asian Spice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose 50-day layoff and fading recent form makes him vulnerable despite his official rating.

runners_data.name: Stone Cold
runners_data.note: NON-RUNNER

runners_data.name: Stinginhisstep
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 181-day absence whose freshness could be asset if others tire from honest pace.

runners_data.name: Anothermanicmonday
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with finishing concerns whose low weight may not compensate for tendency to fade when pressure applied.

runners_data.name: Mrs Pen
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with finishing issues whose recent poor form and low rating make her vulnerable despite weight allowance.

races.paceDynamic: Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack will engage early from the front, with Imperial Jade's class likely telling over Rangatira Jack's honest but limited ability. Green Sky, This Sway and Stinginhisstep will track prominently behind the leaders, keeping tabs on the pace without overexerting. The hold-up brigade of Mr Jukebox, Taritino and Asian Spice will be content to sit off the genuine gallop created by the two front-runners. This honest pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leaders without getting drawn into their battle, positioning them perfectly to strike in the closing stages when the front-runners weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack set honest fractions that leave them vulnerable late
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get the perfect tow and kick clear when the leaders tire, with hold-up horses left with too much to do. Green Sky and This Sway are ideally positioned to capitalise on their tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Jade gets soft sectionals and sees off Rangatira Jack early
scenarios.body: The class horse dictates terms and has enough left to repel late challengers, proving his 100 rating despite the layoff. His tactical speed gives him the race early and his ability maintains the advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong with Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack going too fast
scenarios.body: The front-runners and prominent trackers all come back to the closers in the final furlong. Taritino's recent winning form and Mr Jukebox's hold-up style pay dividends in a slowly-run finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with both leaders stopping quickly
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner from midfield gets first run on the weakening field and holds on grimly. Stinginhisstep's 181-day break could have him fresh enough to capitalise on others' pace exertions.

watchPoints.text: Imperial Jade's 124-day layoff could see him blow up quickly if he tries to match Rangatira Jack's early enthusiasm.
Warren Greatrex's terrible 0/17 recent record makes Mr Jukebox a risky proposition despite his hold-up style suiting the pace shape.
Watch for This Sway to get the perfect stalking position behind the two front-runners as his recent winning form suggests he's well-handicapped.
Taritino needs the leaders to go too fast early to bring his hold-up style into play effectively.
Both Anothermanicmonday and Mrs Pen have shown finishing concerns recently which could be exposed if they need to make up significant ground.

runners_data.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with 7lb claimer but 31 days off after disappointing recent efforts, freshness break could help or hinder.

runners_data.name: Moonlight Artist
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from top yard but poor recent form and struggles to win, may lack the pace to trouble leaders late.

runners_data.name: Elfride

races.paceDynamic: Watchoutitscookie will take this field along from the front with Moonlight Artist likely tracking in second, creating a measured tempo over this extended trip. With six of eight runners adopting hold-up tactics, the early pace will be comfortable and sustainable, allowing the leaders to dictate terms without pressure. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this will develop into a staying test from the home turn, where those who can travel and quicken from off the pace will have the tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the soft early gallop will leave plenty in the tank for a prolonged battle up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains sedate as expected with Watchoutitscookie unopposed
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows hold-up runners to get into perfect rhythm and unleash finishing kicks when it matters. Square Du Roule and Vengeance can time their challenges to perfection in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Watchoutitscookie and Moonlight Artist go too slow early then quicken approaching two out
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners get first run on tired hold-up horses who are caught flat-footed by the change of pace. Watchoutitscookie's 31-day break could provide the freshness edge needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes pedestrian throughout with no one willing to commit until late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most, suiting the highest-rated runners regardless of position. Square Du Roule's recent win and Teorie's consistency become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Ensues
scenarios.trigger: If Moonlight Artist or another challenger decides to press Watchoutitscookie early
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps, making it difficult for hold-up horses to get competitive positions. Those who can adapt tactically and sit closer will benefit from the honest gallop.

watchPoints.text: Elfride's recent habit of pulling up makes her a non-completion risk that could affect the pace if she exits early
Watch Watchoutitscookie's jumping after 31 days off as any mistakes could hand the initiative to Moonlight Artist earlier than planned
Monitor how aggressively Moonlight Artist tracks the leader as Joe Tizzard's runners often race prominently when conditions suit
Square Du Roule needs to overcome the 6lb penalty for his recent win while maintaining his strong course record
Keep an eye on the claim-taking jockeys Robbie David and Isabelle Ryder as both could provide valuable weight relief in a tight finish

runners_data.name: Got A Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid course form but 26 days off and needs to overcome weight burden in small field

runners_data.name: Amatchmadeinheaven
runners_data.note: Natural leader with 7lb claiming allowance but trainer's poor 14-day record of 0/18 is concerning

runners_data.name: Jack Sprat
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up horse for in-form Jamie Snowden but pulled up last time and needs to bounce back

runners_data.name: Mammies Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning quickly from 9-day break with headgear changes suggesting connections expect improvement

runners_data.name: Thank You Blue
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner in excellent recent form but 3lb claimer may struggle with tactical decisions under pressure

runners_data.name: Blue In The West
runners_data.note: Lightweight hold-up horse who won last time but significant class rise from previous company

races.paceDynamic: Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven will go forward from the start, with both confirmed leaders likely to dispute the early pace in this small field. Thank You Blue has been prominent in recent wins while Amatchmadeinheaven led when winning at Ludlow last time, setting up an honest tempo from the off. With four hold-up horses (Got A Dream, Jack Sprat, Mammies Boy, Blue In The West) sitting behind the pace-setters, the race will develop into a tactical affair where the front two may soften each other up. This honest early gallop strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven engage in a pace duel through the early stages.
scenarios.body: The two leaders compromise each other's finishing kicks, allowing the quartet of hold-up horses to sweep past in the closing stages. Got A Dream and Jack Sprat benefit most with their proven ability to quicken late under these conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters (likely Thank You Blue) establishes a clear advantage without serious pressure.
scenarios.body: Thank You Blue's recent winning form suggests he can dictate terms and hold on, especially with his proven stamina at this trip. The hold-up horses may leave their challenges too late on the testing Exeter hill.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Mammies Boy
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: Mammies Boy's trainer Nick Scholfield has a good recent strike rate and this horse showed improved form when fourth last time after a break. His fresh condition could tell in a slowly-run race that becomes tactical.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Amatchmadeinheaven Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Amatchmadeinheaven can steal a march on Thank You Blue and avoid serious early pressure.
scenarios.body: The 7lb claimer Miss Jackson-Fennell takes a valuable weight allowance and this horse showed good tactical speed when leading throughout at Ludlow. An uncontested lead could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven must be monitored for how aggressively they dispute the early lead
Jack Sprat needs close attention after his pulled-up effort last time to see if he travels with his usual enthusiasm
Mammies Boy's headgear changes (blinkers added) could signal improved focus from this hold-up performer
The 7lb claimer on Amatchmadeinheaven may struggle with tactical decisions if the pace becomes stop-start
Blue In The West carries just 147lbs but faces a significant step up in class from his last winning effort

races.paceDynamic: Mythe Bridge will take the field along at a steady but uncontested gallop, with Kit's Coty, Valirann Gold, and Daring Plan sitting handy but unlikely to pressure the leader early. The pace will be sustainable rather than searching, allowing the field to remain competitive deep into the race. With 17 runners and minimal early pressure on Mythe Bridge, this creates a tactical affair where patient hold-up horses can position for late strikes. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can finish fast over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Mythe Bridge maintains an even gallop without serious pressure until the home turn
scenarios.body: The large field compresses turning for home, creating traffic problems for prominent runners while patient hold-up horses find clear runs to unleash finishing kicks. Late pace becomes crucial as fresh finishers sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Kit's Coty or Valirann Gold apply pressure to Mythe Bridge from the 6-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The pace lifts meaningfully in the back straight, stretching the field and creating gaps for prominent runners to exploit. Those positioned handy can kick clear before hold-up horses get organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Mythe Bridge gets an uninterrupted lead and quickens turning for home before others respond
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and builds enough advantage that late closers cannot bridge the gap despite strong finishing efforts. Class and tactical positioning triumph over raw finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too fast too early, creating a stop-start rhythm
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes messy with several horses vying for position, leading to a tactical crawl that favors those with instant acceleration. The race becomes a sprint from the last fence.

watchPoints.text: Mythe Bridge could steal this if getting uncontested lead as returning front runners often benefit from tactical advantage
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 17 runners creating potential trouble for hold-up horses needing clear runs
Conditional jockeys on Valirann Gold, Watchoutitscookie, and Poet's Reflection may lack tactical experience in large competitive fields
Several horses returning from lengthy breaks including Mythe Bridge (50d), Counteract (874d), and Stadmallen (728d) whose fitness must be questioned
Ground reported as Good to Firm for 3m races which may catch out horses better on softer surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Prized Jet and Prairie Queen are the confirmed front runners who will dispute the early lead and set the tempo. With two pacemakers guaranteed to go forward, this creates an honest gallop from the start that will stretch the field over 2m½f. The sustained pace will test stamina reserves and set up the race for the hold-up horses to mount late challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can conserve energy and finish with a flourish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine between Prized Jet and Prairie Queen
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will stretch the field and tire the pace-setters, allowing the patient hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Celtic Queen and Kates Choice are best positioned to exploit this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prairie Queen Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen gets an uncontested lead when Prized Jet fades early
scenarios.body: She can dictate terms from the front and use her superior recent form to hold off late challengers. Her solid staying record suggests she can maintain the gallop to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Monsun Climate Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner gets the perfect tracking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: He can use his class advantage (OR 100) to strike at the right moment when the pace-setters weaken. His tactical style allows him to adapt to the race flow better than pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Prized Jet and Prairie Queen go too fast early and collapse dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any finisher can win from an impossible position. Modern Style's fading tendency makes him vulnerable but others could benefit from the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Prairie Queen could steal this if she gets an uncontested lead when Prized Jet weakens, as her recent form is markedly superior
Monsun Climate's 99-day absence is a significant concern despite his class advantage and could prevent him capitalizing on his rating
The Padster and Modern Style both carry serious tactical concerns - lengthy absence and fading tendency respectively
Watch how aggressively Prized Jet and Prairie Queen dispute the early lead as this will determine the strength of pace
Celtic Queen and Kates Choice should be travelling strongly turning for home if the pace scenario unfolds as expected
